description: Every Datto SaaS Protection (Backupify) client in one local database: seat audits, protection gaps, backup health ranking, exit inventories and plan-first bulk seat changes.

tools.name: activity_log_list
tools.description: List Datto platform activity log entries, filtered by client, user, target or time window. Entries are ordered by date; the direction is not documented. Wire format: GET /v1/report/activity-log with optional clientName, since, sinceUnits, target, targetType, user, _page and _perPage; the response is a pagination plus items envelope. Optional: clientName, since, sinceUnits (plus 5 more). Returns array of ActivityLogEntry.

params.name: clientName
params.description: Client name for a partial or prefix match.

params.name: since
params.description: Window to return logs for. Sources disagree on the format: S3 sends a number of sinceUnits (for example 7 with sinceUnits=days), S6 (Logiphys tools.go) sends an ISO 8601 date. Passed through unchanged.

params.name: targetType
params.description: Target type to filter on, e.g. bcdr-device.

params.name: user
params.description: User name for a partial or prefix match.

tools.name: applications_list
tools.description: Show one customer's backup report: used bytes, backup history per suite and app, and optional remote IDs per seat type. The remote IDs and per-seat-type counts are returned with includeRemoteID=1. Wire format: GET /v1/saas/{saasCustomerId}/applications?daysUntil=N&includeRemoteID=0|1; the response is a pagination plus items envelope. Required: saasCustomerId. Optional: daysUntil, includeRemoteID. Returns array of ApplicationReport.

params.name: saasCustomerId
params.description: SaaS Protection customer ID, from the domains list.

params.name: daysUntil
params.description: Day window for the report. Sources disagree on its meaning: S2 and S3 describe it as days until the report is generated, S5 treats it as days of backup history. S2 says the API defaults to 10 and, as of 2024-02, returns data up to 30.

params.name: includeRemoteID
params.description: Include remote IDs per seat type, 0 = no, 1 = yes.

tools.name: backup_stats_get-detailed
tools.description: Show detailed backup statistics for one SaaS customer. Wire format: GET /v1/saas/{saasCustomerId}/detailedBackupStats with no query parameters; returns one JSON object whose shape is not publicly documented, so every field is optional. Required: saasCustomerId.

params.name: saasCustomerId
params.description: SaaS Protection customer ID, from the domains list.

tools.name: domains_list
tools.description: List every protected Microsoft 365 tenant and Google Workspace domain, with its saasCustomerId and subscription id. One row per domain; a customer with several domains appears once per domain. Wire format: GET /v1/saas/domains with no query parameters; the response is a bare JSON array of domain objects. Returns array of Domain.

tools.name: seats_bulk-change
tools.description: License, pause, or unlicense up to 100 seats of one subscription in one call. This is a write that changes which seats are protected and billed. Wire format: PUT /v1/saas/{saasCustomerId}/{externalSubscriptionId}/bulkSeatChange with JSON body {'seat_type': 'User', 'action_type': 'License', 'ids': ['<remoteId>']}. Take saasCustomerId and externalSubscriptionId from the domains list and ids from the seats list remoteId. Google Workspace tenants must be on Seat Management 2.0. Never replayed automatically, because a 5xx may already have been applied. Required: saasCustomerId, externalSubscriptionId, action_type, ids, seat_type. Returns array of BulkSeatChangeResult.

params.name: saasCustomerId
params.description: SaaS Protection customer ID, from the domains list.

params.name: externalSubscriptionId
params.description: Subscription key from the domains list, e.g. Classic:Office365:654321.

params.name: action_type
params.description: License protects the seat (billable), Pause keeps existing backups but stops new ones, Unlicense stops protecting the seat.

params.name: ids
params.description: Remote (live M365 or Google) object IDs, the seats endpoint remoteId values. At most 100: Datto recommends that batch size (S1) and this CLI enforces it locally (as S5 does); a server-side limit is not documented.

params.name: seat_type
params.description: Seat type. M365: User, SharedMailbox, Site, TeamSite, Team. Google: User, SharedDrive.

tools.name: seats_list
tools.description: List the seats of one SaaS customer with seat type, state, billable flag, date added and remoteId. Wire format: GET /v1/saas/{saasCustomerId}/seats with an optional seatType query; the response is a bare JSON array of seats. Required: saasCustomerId. Optional: seatType. Returns array of Seat.

params.name: saasCustomerId
params.description: SaaS Protection customer ID, from the domains list.

params.name: seatType
params.description: Case-sensitive seat type filter: User, SharedMailbox, SharedDrive, Site, TeamSite or Team. Several types may be passed comma-separated, e.g. User,Site.

novel_features.name: Bulk change planner
novel_features.description: Turn a seat selection into ready-to-run License, Pause or Unlicense batches, grouped by subscription and seat type and capped at 100 ids, without sending anything.

novel_features.name: Billing reconciliation
novel_features.description: See, per client, where Datto's seatsUsed disagrees with billable and Active seats before you invoice.

novel_features.name: Protection gaps
novel_features.description: List seats across all clients that are Unprotected (Paused too with --include-paused), newest first, with each seat's remoteId for a License plan.

novel_features.name: Backup health ranking
novel_features.description: Rank clients worst first by backup coverage, then consecutive short backup windows and perfect-backup rate.

novel_features.name: Exit inventory
novel_features.description: Build one manifest for a client leaving SaaS Protection: domains, subscription ids, retention, every seat with remoteId, storage, last backups and a blockers checklist.

novel_features.name: Seat roster
novel_features.description: Every synced seat across all clients in one table, joined with its customer's domains, product types and subscription ids; --csv for a fleet-wide export.

novel_features.name: Seat summary
novel_features.description: Seat counts per client and seat type, split by Active, Paused, Archived and Unprotected state and the billable flag.
